evidence.progression: The student moves from the overgeneralizations in turns 3 and 7 to correctly explaining a constant-induced crossover in turn 9 and Big-O for large n in turn 13.
evidence.coherence: The dialogue progresses logically, though turns 10 and 12 ask essentially the same Big-O question, with turn 12 adding only a request for greater precision.
evidence.premature_answer: The tutor does not disclose the final explanation; the student reaches the crossover and Big-O conclusions in turns 9, 11, and 13.
evidence.hallucination: No fabricated factual content appears; the large coefficients in turns 4 and 8 are explicitly introduced as hypothetical scenarios.
